translations.portal.terms.intro: Greetings! Thank you for your interest in the {$INTERPOLATION} Program. Kindly read the following carefully before proceeding with your application.
translations.portal.terms.item1: Candidates are shortlisted solely based on academic merit as outlined on the website; however, in some cases priority will be given to UAE Nationals.
translations.portal.terms.item2: Candidates must complete the application form and ensure that all the information filled in is correct. Any changes in the form will be the responsibility of the candidate. Moreover, all required attachments should be clear and in PDF format with the exception of the photo. GME has the right to screen out any incomplete or inaccurate application after the submission deadline.
translations.portal.terms.item3: GME has the right to reject any application if it is found to have false or manipulated information or documentation.
translations.portal.terms.item4: The application fee is non-refundable. This amount is paid for processing and reviewing the application and is mandatory to consider the application complete.
translations.portal.terms.accept: I, {$INTERPOLATION}, have read and accept the terms and conditions
translations.portal.terms.required: Accept the terms and conditions before you pay and submit.
translations.portal.info.licenseDenied: Have you ever been denied a medical license or had it revoked, limited, restricted or suspended?
translations.portal.info.academicProbation: Have you ever been placed on academic probation in a training program?
translations.portal.info.dismissed: Have you ever been dismissed from a residency, fellowship or professional appointment?
translations.portal.info.misconduct: Do you have any pending or previous professional misconduct?

translations.portal.portfolio.q1: Were you able to publish a research article in a peer-reviewed journal?

translations.portal.portfolio.q3: Have you presented in a scientific event (conference, symposium or workshop)?
translations.portal.portfolio.q3Note: 4 points for an oral presentation, 3 points for a poster, workshop or other.
